population: Observed strict sale contracts, excluding land leasehold, 84<=exclusive area<85 square metres; current Seoul25 and collected Gyeonggi36 master regions
rank_rule: Descending competition rank with inclusive tie interval; exact unrounded values
influence_definition: Number of visible regions whose supported one-complex deletion rank interval spans at least ten positions; other regions fixed; original rank included; both anonymous groups require ten regions
limitations: Retrospective snapshot, not the information available at the contract date
Changing transaction composition and true market movement are not separated
Not a same-home index, confidence interval, forecast or investment ranking
Named deletion statistics, precise complex counts and concentration shares are withheld
Median support review and exact linear sum/count certificates are not a general privacy guarantee
